lock_reaches_natural_expiry.meaning: the user's lock reaches its natural expiry without manual extension
lock_reaches_natural_expiry.checkpoint: before claimRewards for the expiry epoch

lock_end_le_epoch_end.meaning: the lock end timestamp is at or before the end timestamp of the epoch in which the lock expires
lock_end_le_epoch_end.checkpoint: before claimRewards for the expiry epoch

user_bonded_final_epoch.meaning: the user was bonded for part or all of the epoch in which the lock expires
user_bonded_final_epoch.checkpoint: before claimRewards for the expiry epoch

pro_rata_share_final_epoch.meaning: the user's pro-rata share of the expiry epoch's rewards for the bonded portion
pro_rata_share_final_epoch.checkpoint: before claimRewards for the expiry epoch

assumptions: Rewards for epoch n become claimable in epoch n+1 and are forfeited if not claimed before the next epoch ends.
The user's pro-rata share for the bonded portion of the expiry epoch is positive when the user was bonded for part or all of that epoch.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of the user's pro-rata share of the expiry epoch's rewards; pro_rata_share_final_epoch is a symbolic reference quantity grounded only by the intent statement.
Report does not state whether the user actually calls claimRewards or whether the zero epoch-end snapshot alone determines the loss.

limitations: Proportional fairness is expressed as equality between the eligible rewards and the symbolic pro-rata share; no division or rate is defined.
The claim is formalized only for the final/expiry epoch impact; other reported impacts are not covered by this plan.
